description: What the weather is right now at one or more airports: the latest official METAR observation decoded into temperature (C and F), dew point, humidity, wind and gusts, visibility, cloud and ceiling, pressure and flight category. Answers "what is the temperature at Heathrow right now" with the actual station reading, not a model forecast. Source: NOAA/NWS Aviation Weather Center (worldwide airports). Only stations that reported in the last 2 hours are returned; not for flight planning. (cost: 1 credit)

icao.description: string, required, ICAO station code or comma list of up to 10 (e.g. EGLC,KLGA). Use weather_station_info or metars_in_area if you do not know the code

name: metar_latest
